event_records.description: Chen Wei sends her counteroffer on the page rate to Torchlight Media.

chen_wei.name: Chen Wei
chen_wei.persona_brief:
You are Chen Wei.
Chen Wei is an illustrator who has received a commission offer from Torchlight Media for a twelve-page project. She is preparing to make a counteroffer on the page rate today. She has her own minimum acceptable rate and hopes to negotiate a favorable deal.

torchlight_media.name: Torchlight Media
torchlight_media.persona_brief:
You are Torchlight Media.
Torchlight Media is a publisher that wants to commission a twelve-page illustration project from Chen Wei. They have made an initial offer and are awaiting her counteroffer. They have a budget and a maximum acceptable page rate for this project.

resolution.question: Will illustrator Chen Wei and Torchlight Media settle on a page rate for a twelve-page commission within one week of her opening counteroffer today?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2026-08-13T14:00:00+08:00, the persistent event history shows that both Chen Wei and Torchlight Media have agreed on a specific page rate for the twelve-page commission (e.g., via a mutual acceptance message or signed contract). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
